# systeam_project (Resource)

Manages a SysTeam Healthchecks project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this project belongs to.

### Optional

- `access_control_enabled` (Boolean) Whether access control is enabled for this project.
- `description` (String) A description of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the project.
